changeinfo.changes:
- Complete redesign of the interface and visual style. - Improvementss and visual adaptation of the integrated VitaShell. - Integration and modification of Plugin Manager. - Integration and modification of Theme Manager. - New and improved built-in file viewers.
- Improved book reader with support for PDF, MOBI, AZW and compressed archives. - Improved Music Player with AT9 and AT3 support. - Added customizable background music.
- HomebrewUpdate integration with status detection. - Redesigned installation and progress dialogs. - Added English and French translations for the new features. - Fixed several longstanding bugs and improved overall stability. - General improvements to navigation and interface consistency. - Compiled with the latest VitaSDK.
- Updated VitaShell QR scanner — refactored by isage. - Updated VitaShell OTG support — developed by LiEnby.
